title: [Bug]: [Subscription Billing] Payment discount on contract invoices comes from the customer, not from the contract's payment terms
summary: Payment discount percentages on subscription billing invoices now correctly use the contract's payment terms instead of the customer or vendor's payment terms.
key_points: Invoices created from contracts now take Payment Discount % from the contract's payment terms, not the customer's or vendor's
Create Billing Documents re-validates the contract Payment Terms Code after the document date is set
Sales and purchase headers are handled differently because their payment terms triggers behave differently
Four new tests cover contract terms that grant a discount and contract terms that remove one, for both customers and vendors
Before the fix, the payment discount could be missing or larger than the contract terms allow
